parsed.brief_reason: The patch removes the entire loop that calculates the capacity increase for string replacement, replacing it with blank lines. This deletes core functionality that optimizes buffer allocation and will cause performance degradation. While it may pass the specific test by avoiding a NullPointerException, it does so by gutting essential logic rather than fixing the underlying null-handling issue.
